_note: Baseline versions of every upstream data source. The monthly data-refresh GitHub Action (.github/workflows/data-refresh.yml) compares the live API sources against these and flags the manual sources for a human check. To 'register' an update, bump the value here in the same PR that ingests the new data.

worldbank_pop65.label: World Bank — population ages 65+ (% of total) → aging layer

who_gho_smoking.label: WHO GHO — estimate of current tobacco use → smoking PAF

who_gho_inactivity.label: WHO GHO — insufficient physical activity → inactivity PAF

ncdrisc_bp.label: NCD-RisC — raised blood pressure → hypertension PAF

acag_pm25.label: ACAG / WashU — satellite surface PM2.5 → PM2.5 layers

lancet_commission.label: Lancet Commission on dementia — relative risks (RRs)

bai_mci.label: Bai 2022 — global MCI meta-analysis → MCI regional baseline
